708250401.text: *sigh* If we just had a couple more people on hand...

708250403.text: Maintaining the city's defenses, helping with the rebuilding effort, and a whole host of other odd jobs.

708250404.text: Every last knight we have is up to their eyeballs in work right now.

708250405.text: For once, guard duty at the main gate is the relatively easy job.

708250407.text: In fact, we're lucky to have had their assistance from the outset. At first, they were helping find and rescue victims in the city, more recently they've been keeping watch on monster activity further afield.

708250408.text: When the monsters began gathering near to the city, it was thanks to the adventurers who carried out early reconnaissance and reported back to us that we were able to make specific and effective plans for the defense effort.

708250409.text: Even now, they are hard at work supporting all our efforts to get the city back on its feet. Honestly, without them, the Knights would be starting to crumble under the load.

708250410.text: I must make time to thank Cyrus properly...

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat all opponents and dismantle their camp

708250501.text: He wasn't kidding, look at all this junk. Worst thing in the world for foot traffic...

708250502.text: Let's smash them all to pieces!

708250503.text: There's still more? How'd they put up all these in such a short time, anyway?

708250504.text: Ugh, what does it matter. Let's clear them all up, then we won't have to think about it any longer.

708250505.text: There are soooo many! Geez, how long were they planning this for?

708250506.text: Not long enough, clearly! The last traces of their big master plan are disappearing right before Paimon's very eyes!

708250507.text: Come on, let's clean this area up, pronto!

708250508.text: Alrighty, our work here is done. Let's go speak to Huffman again.

subQuests.subQuestName: Patrol the area and clear any obstacles

708250601.text: How's your progress? Finished clearing the area yet?

708250603.text: Fantastic. You've been an enormous help, who knows how much longer those ugly things would've been stood there otherwise...

708250604.text: Honorary Knight, please accept these as an expression of my gratitude.
